The repeated signals remain: (1) C1/C2 are too thin for AI & High-tech's and partly Consulting's current market/value logic; (2) C7 is too thin for Intelligence & Knowledge and Media's ecosystem-position and sources-of-advantage logic; (3) A4/B6 are too thin for Investments' governance and ownership-economics dependence; and (4) D1/D5 remain too thin for PXS OS capability anchoring and current evidence references. The adjacent-BU boundary cluster remains decision-conversion work first, not fresh model-gap discovery.
